= Get tags and metadata

[.api-doc-operation .api-doc-operation-get]#GET# [.api-doc-code-block]#`/items/{id}`#



Retrieves an item along with its tag map and a prose-only related object.

== Parameters

[cols=5*,options=header]
|===
|Name
|Type
|In
|Required
|Description

|id
|string
|path
|True
a|Item identifier

|===

Status: 200, OK

[cols=4*,options=header]

|Name
|Type
|Required
|Description

|tags
|link:#tags[tags]
|False
a|Map of tag name to value.


|targetSchema
|link:#targetSchema[targetSchema]
|False
a|Out-of-band schema reference described in prose.


|===
